sentences.text: the structures of the Petitioner.
Under these Awards, [ both, for the land and the structures], the total amount of compensation determined was Rs.17,55,55,699/-.
Thereafter, by order dated 6 th May 2022, the amount awarded to the Petitioner was reduced by Rs. 4,13,73,617/-.
It is being aggrieved by this deduction that the above Writ Petition is filed.
2. On 5th September 2023, the parties agreed that in the larger public interest and also in national interest, a public project ought not to be delayed.

Accordingly, with consent of the parties, this Court, inter-alia directed that an amount of Rs. 13,41,82,082/-, shall be deposited by Respondent No. 3 with the office of Sub Divisional Office, Kalyan within a period of 14 days from the date of the said order and the disputed amount of Rs. 4,13,73,617/- would then be deposited in this Court which would then be invested in Fixed Deposits of any nationalised bank and shall abide by further orders passed in this Writ Petition.

This order was passed without prejudice to the rights and contentions of all parties including the right of the Petitioner seeking enhancement of compensation, if any, as also the contention of Respondent No. 3 (wrongly mentioned as NOVEMBER 09, 2023 Yugandhara Patil 8-WP-7217-2022.doc Respondent No. 2 in Order dated 5 th September 2023) that the present Writ Petition is not maintainable.

3. The matter has been moved today because it is apprehension of the Petitioner that the possession receipt which they have been asked to sign states that they will not claim any enhanced compensation.

The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Petitioner, submitted that the compensation being paid by the State under the said receipts, is under Section 31 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (
for short " the 2013 Act") read with the Rehabilitation & Resettlement policy of the State Government dated 22nd May 2018 ("R&R award" for short).

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He submitted that the Petitioner is not seeking any enhancement of compensation with reference to the said R&R award.

He submitted that it should therefore be clarified that by executing the aforesaid possession receipt, it should not be construed to mean that the Petitioner has given up its right to seek enhanced compensation in relation to the main Awards passed in the above matter namely 3 land Awards and one structures Award, more particularly set out in our Order dated 5 th September 2023.
NOVEMBER 09, 2023 Yugandhara Patil 8-WP-7217-2022.doc 4.
After hearing the parties, we find that the arguments canvassed by the Petitioner have merit.
By our dated 5 th September 2023, the parties had consented that the right of the Petitioner to seek enhanced compensation (in respect of main Awards), if any, is expressly kept open.

Once this is the case, we clarify that the possession receipt to be executed by the Petitioner, will not preclude them from seeking enhanced compensation, if so advised, in relation to the 3 land Awards and one structures Award referred to in our order dated 5th September 2023.

5. We make it clear that the Petitioner will not be able to seek any enhancement of compensation in relation to the R&R Award paid by the State Government under Section 31 of the 2013 Act read with its Policy dated 22nd May 2018.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Petitioner, submitted that the compensation being paid by the State under the said receipts, is under Section 31 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (
for short " the 2013 Act") read with the Rehabilitation & Resettlement policy of the State Government dated 22nd May 2018 ("R&R award" for short).
He submitted that the Petitioner is not seeking any enhancement of compensation with reference to the said R&R award.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: He submitted that it should therefore be clarified that by executing the aforesaid possession receipt, it should not be construed to mean that the Petitioner has given up its right to seek enhanced compensation in relation to the main Awards passed in the above matter namely 3 land Awards and one structures Award, more particularly set out in our Order dated 5 th September 2023.
opennyai_summary.decision:
After hearing the parties, we find that the arguments canvassed by the Petitioner have merit.
By our dated 5 th September 2023, the parties had consented that the right of the Petitioner to seek enhanced compensation (in respect of main Awards), if any, is expressly kept open.
Once this is the case, we clarify that the possession receipt to be executed by the Petitioner, will not preclude them from seeking enhanced compensation, if so advised, in relation to the 3 land Awards and one structures Award referred to in our order dated 5th September 2023.
5. We make it clear that the Petitioner will not be able to seek any enhancement of compensation in relation to the R&R Award paid by the State Government under Section 31 of the 2013 Act read with its Policy dated 22nd May 2018.
This clarification puts an end to any apprehension of the Petitioner.
Accordingly, they shall now proceed to execute the possession receipts as expeditiously as possible and in any event within a period of one week from today.
